name: Frostbite
description: Damaging a unit frostbites it for %duration% turns, cutting it off from all healing.
details: A frostbitten unit shatters and dies instantly the moment it falls below %kill_threshold:pct%% of its maximum health.

upgrade.summary: Lasts %duration% turns, and basic units shatter below %basic_kill_threshold:pct%% health.
details: A frostbitten unit shatters and dies instantly the moment it falls below %kill_threshold:pct%% of its maximum health.
A frostbitten basic unit shatters at %basic_kill_threshold:pct%% instead - far more of them are already inside that margin.
